senses.gloss: ch. same, to stand still; to tarry, gaze, be astonished.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 43:10">Targ. Y. Gen. XLIII, 10</cite>.

Joḥ. gave his opinion) and was silent (and in the meanwhile R. Asi left the college room); <cite ref="Shevuot 40a:6">Shebu. 40ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shevuot 45b:6">45ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Beitzah 6a:3">Bets. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>לא אמרן אלא דא׳ … מַשְׁהִינָן ליה</he> they allow burial on the second festive day only when the corpse has been lying for some time, but if it was not, we postpone its burial.
<cite ref="Yevamot 80b:1">Yeb. 80ᵇ</cite> <he>אִשְׁתְּהוּיֵי הוא דא׳</he> its birth was delayed.
<cite ref="Yevamot 80b:6">Ib.</cite> <cite ref="M02995"><he>מִשְׁתְּהָא</he></cite> a birth may be delayed (beyond the time of maturity).
<cite ref="Yevamot 80b:2">Ib.</cite> <he>וא׳ עד תריסר וכ׳</he> and he (the husband) tarried (was away from home) as much as twelve months; a. e.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 7:10">Targ. Y. Deut. VII, 10</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 22:22">Ib. XXII, 22</cite> <he>לֹא תַשְׁהוּנָהּ</he> (ed. Vien. <he>תִשְׁהוֹנֵיה</he>, corr. acc.) do not delay her execution.—Bets. l. c., v. supra.
